extra.message: This state-changing route handler authenticates the caller (Depends(get_current_user)) but declares no RolesBasedAuthChecker role dependency. Any authenticated user, regardless of role, can invoke it — a possible missing function-level authorization check (BFLA). If a role gate is required, add auth=Depends(RolesBasedAuthChecker([...])).
